notes.title: 100th player update!
notes.notes:
We hit our 100th player of the game!! It's not that many, but it's definitely an achievement!
The 100th player also gave me a ton of the most useful feedback, and this update implements most of the things that I noticed needed to be changed. 

[list]
Fixed: 
[*] Harvesters and Planters now disappear when expected, compared to never.
[*] In-game time no longer ticks by when in any part of the main menu or pause menu (character selection, load, options, credits...)
[*] Some NPC's no longer get stuck in colliders.
[*] Character choice would sometimes show a character as a jumbled mess.
[*] Entering a menu while running stops augmenting the running time limit.
[*] Picking up crafting stations no removes the Gumption it added when placed.
[*] An undertaking was not showing its text in the Undertaking menu.
[*] Running UI shatter effect resets correctly after running meter is back down to 0.
[*] Equipped items now show in the correct spot when in the exhausted animation.

Changed:
[*] Torches can now be equipped in players hand from the inventory UI.
[*] Fixable torches now have the same crafting requirements as the normally crafted torch.
[*] Farm areas require less Agency (paw icon) to fix.
[*] Added a pulsing color to the energy holder of crafting stations when the holder is empty.
[*] Crafting station ingredients will now show the name of the item if you hover over it.
[*] Crafting recipes, crafting energy slot and chrafting queue now all indicate their time.
[*] Little arrow tutorial resets if you didn't finish the tutorial the first time.
[*] When missing Agency for an action it now show the total needed, not the amount missing.

Added:
[*] Auto-save feature, happens when exiting the tabbed menu (inventory, compendiums...) 
[*] if more then 10 minutes have passed since the last auto-save. This can be enabled/disabled in the options menu.
[*] Recipes and craftable items in your compendiums now show what station is used to craft said recipe/item.
[*] 
[/list]

notes.title: The Zia Update

Welcome to the Zia update - 0.05.05! 

A few changes have been made to the core gameplay, which in turn affects balancing, a needed adjustment that is far from over. Bellow are the changes and additions. 

[list]
[*] Added: You can now drop multiple items from a stack in your inventory.
[*] Added: Blips and Bloops added to most buttons.
[*] 
[*] Changed: Crafting stations now require a consumable energy source to function.
[*] Changed: Running the game in background, or not, when tabbing out of the game is now a toggle in options.
[*] Changed: It is now clearly shown if the name of your character is valid or not.
[*]
[*] Fixed: When starting a brand new play-through the options are set correctly.
[*] Fixed: All items, recipes, conversations or undertakings are now being set as existing in the game-world, which was occasionally causing the save file to fail.
[/list]

[list]

notes.title: A new demo has been released!
notes.notes:
I just now released a demo of [i]A look into...[/i] and I'll have to admit that it is a bit nerve-wracking.

The point of the demo at the moment is to get some feedback from whomever decides to play it at this early stage. While I've been working on this project for the past two (almost 3) years, I also know that it is still in its early stages. There is a lot to add, more to change, and a lifetime of fine-tuning and bug-fixing. But the only way for me to know what's what in an ocean of options is to let people play it where it's at and wait for feedback.

I'm open to any discussion people might want to have regarding the project, so let me know here if you have anything to say.

Thank you for your eyes, ears and time, and I hope to have made it somewhat worthwhile!
